get.description:
Returns the shop's daily settlement statements from TikTok. TikTok cuts one statement each day at 00:00 UTC covering the previous day's settled transactions, with data from 2023-07-01. Each row has `id`, `statementTime`, `currency`, `settlementAmount`, `revenueAmount`, `feeAmount`, `adjustmentAmount`, `netSalesAmount`, `shippingCostAmount`, `paymentStatus` (`PAID`, `FAILED` or `PROCESSING`), `paymentId` (null while processing) and `paymentTime`.

Filter with `statement_time_ge` (inclusive) and `statement_time_lt` (exclusive), both Unix seconds, and with `payment_status`. Results are newest first unless you set `sort_order=ASC`. `page_size` is 1 to 100 (TikTok's default is 20). Pass `nextPageToken` back as `page_token`; it is null on the last page. To match a bank deposit, use `settlementAmount` and `paymentId`, then open the statement's transactions. Amounts keep TikTok's signs. Read live from TikTok on every call.

get.description:
Lists every transaction settled in one statement: orders (`type` `ORDER`), adjustments (with `adjustmentId`, `adjustmentOrderId` and `adjustmentAmount`) and reserves (`RESERVE`, with `reserveAmount`, `reserveStatus` `COLLECTED` or `RELEASED`, and `estimatedReleaseTime`). Take `statementId` from Settlement statements.

The response carries `payableAmount` (settlement plus reserve), `totalSettlementAmount`, `totalReserveAmount`, `totalSettlementBreakdown` and `totalCount`. Order rows include revenue, shipping, fee and tax amounts with breakdown maps; affiliate commission is `feeTaxBreakdown.fee.affiliateCommissionAmount`. Rows have no currency of their own and use the statement's `currency`. US cross-border data starts 2025-04-30. Rows are sorted by order create time, newest first unless you set `sort_order=ASC`. `page_size` is 1 to 100; pass `nextPageToken` back as `page_token`. Read live from TikTok.

get.description:
Returns the settled revenue, fees, shipping and settlement for one order, split per SKU. Order-level fields are `revenueAmount` (net sales), `feeAndTaxAmount`, `shippingCostAmount`, `settlementAmount` and `currency`. Each `skuTransactions` row adds `skuId`, `skuName`, `productName`, `quantity`, `statementId` (the payout it landed in) and breakdown maps.

Affiliate commission is `feeTaxBreakdown.fee.affiliateCommissionAmount`, plus `affiliatePartnerCommissionAmount`, `affiliateAdsCommissionAmount` and `cofundedCreatorBonusAmount` when present. An order that hasn't settled yet has no rows here; use Unsettled transactions for estimates. Read live from TikTok.

Lists orders and adjustments that TikTok hasn't settled yet, created on or after 2025-01-01. Every amount is TikTok's estimate and can change before settlement. Final numbers only come from the statement endpoints.

The response has `totalCount`, the sums `sumEstSettlementAmount`, `sumEstRevenueAmount`, `sumEstAdjustmentAmount` and `sumEstFeeAmount`, and `currency` (set only when every row on the page shares one). Each row has `type`, `orderId`, `orderCreateTime`, `orderDeliveryTime`, `unsettledReason`, the `est*` amounts with breakdown maps, and `estimatedSettlement`: a text rule such as days after delivery before the order is delivered, then a Unix-seconds string. Filter on order create time with `search_time_ge` (inclusive) and `search_time_lt` (exclusive), in Unix seconds. Newest first by default. `page_size` is 1 to 100; pass `nextPageToken` back as `page_token`. Read live from TikTok.

get.description:
Lists money moving in and out of the shop's TikTok balance. `type` is `WITHDRAW` (the seller withdrew to a bank card), `SETTLE` (TikTok settled to the seller), `TRANSFER` (a platform subsidy or deduction) or `REVERSE` (a withdrawal failed on a bad bank card). Each row has `id`, `type`, `amount`, `currency`, `status` (`PROCESSING`, `SUCCESS` or `FAILED`) and `createTime`. No bank account data is returned.

Pass `types` as a comma-separated list to filter (default: all four). `create_time_ge` (inclusive) and `create_time_lt` (exclusive) take Unix seconds. `page_size` is 1 to 100; pass `nextPageToken` back as `page_token`. Read live from TikTok.

get.description:
Returns a profit and loss for a date window, built live from TikTok's settlement statements. Each line (`groups[]` and `totals`) has `revenue`, `refunds`, `shipping`, `feesAndTaxes` with `fees` and `taxes` maps, `platformCommission`, `affiliateCommission`, `adjustments`, `adjustmentsByType`, `reserve` and `settlement`, plus row counts. Amounts are exact decimal strings in `currency`, summed with TikTok's own signs, so fees are negative. Reserves are kept out of `settlement`.

`start_date` and `end_date` are activity days, YYYY-MM-DD, UTC, both inclusive, at most 365 days apart. TikTok cuts one statement a day at 00:00 UTC covering the day before, so each activity day maps to the statement stamped the next day. `group_by` is `total` (default), `day` or `sku`. With `sku`, adjustments, reserves and orders that couldn't be read go to `unallocated`. A window whose statements are in more than one currency is rejected.

Large windows can be cut short. When `truncated` is true, `truncatedReasons` and `coverage` say what was left out, and `statements.headerTotals` still sums the header of every listed statement. Narrow the window to get full coverage.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Last activity day, YYYY-MM-DD, UTC, inclusive. At most 365 days after start_date.

parameters.description: total, day (activity day: statement UTC date minus one) or sku.

get.description:
Checks orders created in a window against what TikTok actually settled. The orders are the shop's affiliate orders, the same set as Affiliate order lines, so orders with no creator attribution aren't included. Each order gets a `status`: `settled`, `partially_settled` (settled rows plus a later unsettled row, such as an adjustment), `unsettled`, `not_found`, `unknown`, `unchecked` or `error`.

Per order you get `stored` (Growi's synced view: SKU lines, units, `gmv`, settlement statuses, estimated and actual commission), `settled` (TikTok's `settlementAmount`, `revenueAmount`, `feeAndTaxAmount`, `shippingCostAmount`, `affiliateCommission` and `statementIds`) and `unsettled` (TikTok's estimates). For settled orders, `mismatch` compares the affiliate commission TikTok deducted at settlement with the commission reported on the affiliate order; `against` says whether that was the actual or estimated figure, and `delta` (settled minus stored) is flagged when it exceeds `tolerance` (default `0.01`). `summary` counts the page by status. Amounts are exact decimal strings.

`start_date` and `end_date` are order-create days, YYYY-MM-DD, UTC, inclusive, at most 365 days apart. Orders are newest first. `limit` is up to 50 (default 25), and each order costs one TikTok call. Pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor` with the same window. `sweptThrough` shows how fresh the stored side is. When time runs out, `truncated` is true and some orders come back `unchecked` or `unknown`.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: First order-create day, YYYY-MM-DD, UTC, inclusive.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Last order-create day, YYYY-MM-DD, UTC, inclusive. At most 365 days after start_date.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Orders per page. Each order costs one TikTok call.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor from the previous page, same window.

parameters.name: tolerance
parameters.description: Absolute commission difference allowed before a settled order is a mismatch.

parameters.name: organization_id
parameters.description: Use the TikTok Shop of this child brand (organization id) of your API key's organization

200.description: { window, basis: affiliate_orders.order_create_time_utc, sweptThrough, tolerance, currency, orders: [{ orderId, orderCreateTime, status, stored, settled, unsettled, mismatch, error }], summary: { orders, settled: { count, settlementAmount }, partiallySettled, unsettled: { count, estSettlementAmount }, notFound, unknown, unchecked, errors, mismatches }, nextCursor, truncated, truncatedReasons }

get.description:
Lists every Shop Performance Score metric for the shop. Each has `metricCode`, `metricName`, `dimension`, `value` and `valueUnit` (`PERCENT` or `HOURS`), `score` (0 to 5), `status`, TikTok's `benchmarks` (`excellentThreshold` and `poorThreshold`) and the evaluation window (`evaluateDurationDays`, `evaluationStartsAt`, `evaluationEndsAt`). `topReasonText` is set when TikTok marks the metric as a key contributor to the score.

`status` is `EXCELLENT`, `GOOD`, `POOR`, `CRITICAL` or `NIL`. `NIL` means there isn't enough data to score the metric, not a zero score. TikTok advises using `status` rather than comparing `value` to the thresholds yourself, since whether higher or lower is better depends on the metric. US shops only. `locale` localizes names and text. Read live from TikTok.

get.description:
Returns TikTok's diagnosis of one Shop Performance Score metric: its value, score, status and benchmarks, a daily `trend`, the `calculation` behind it (numerator and denominator with labels), how its problem cases split in `distribution`, and TikTok's diagnostic text in `analyses` (empty when TikTok has none).

`metricCode` is case-insensitive. Current codes are `NRR` (negative review rate), `NBFR` (non-buyer-fault return and refund rate), `SFCR` (seller-fault cancellation rate), `OTDR` (on-time delivery rate), `AHT` (after-sales handling time) and `IM_DSAT` (chat dissatisfaction rate). TikTok may add more. `trend_duration_days` sets the trend length, 1 to 365, default 30. US shops only. Read live from TikTok.

post.description:
Searches TikTok's Creator Marketplace by filters and returns one page of creators, in TikTok's order. Use it to find creators the shop hasn't worked with yet. Each row has `openId` (use it for invites and DMs), `username`, followers, average shoppable views, GMV (precise `gmv` only when the creator shares it, else `gmvRange`), `unitsSoldRange`, top follower demographics and a `profile` block.

Send filters in the JSON body: `keyword` (matches username and nickname only), `followers` (count, age ranges, gender share in basis points), `gmvRanges` and `unitsSoldRanges` (TikTok's four fixed buckets), `categories`, `contentPerformance`, `affiliate` (commission, post rate, agency status, fast-growing, not invited in 90 days) and `advanced` (region options and sort order from Discovery filters). All metrics cover the last 30 days. `pageSize` is 12 or 20. Unknown keys are rejected.

To page, pass `nextPageToken` back as `pageToken` along with `searchKey`. `hasMore` is false on the last page. Each call spends TikTok marketplace search quota, so Growi applies a per-shop daily cap (2,000 by default, reset at 00:00 UTC), and the `quota` block shows what's left. TikTok sometimes returns thin pages, so a short page doesn't mean the market is empty.

get.description:
Lists the shop's target collaborations, one page per call, including ones created in Seller Center. Each row has `id`, `name`, the invite `message`, `startTime`, `endTime`, `createTime` and `updateTime` (Unix seconds), `type` (`STANDARD` or `TOP_CREATOR_PROGRAM`), `counts` (invited, showcase creators, content creators, products) and `freeSampleRule`.

Rows don't carry their own status. Filter with `keyword` plus `keywordType` (`PRODUCT_ID`, `PRODUCT_NAME`, `TARGET_COLLABORATION_ID` or `TARGET_COLLABORATION_NAME`; the name types are fuzzy), `creatorOpenId`, `creatorAcceptStatus` and `freeSampleSetting`. `pageSize` is 20, 50 or 100 (default 100). Pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor`. For shops connected without TikTok's official API, only `ONGOING`, `EXPIRING` or `COMPLETED` with no other filter work, and fields are best effort (`source: web`). imageUrl.description: Our stored main image. null when we never saw one.

taxExclusivePrice.description: Local display price for local sellers; pre-tax price for global sellers.

inventory.description: In-stock units summed over warehouses. null when TikTok sent no inventory.

imageUrl.description: Our stored SKU image (R2 mirror, else TikTok's URL). null when we never saw one.

currency.description: null when products came back in more than one currency, or when there were no products. Every amount and share is then null too.

skuOrders.description: Summed per product, so an order with two products counts twice (it matches the shop's SKU orders, not its orders).

channels.description: Always the six channels, in a fixed order. They do not overlap and their gmv adds up to total.gmv.

shopTab.description: Shop tab sales and traffic. Overlaps the channels, so its share is not part of their sum.

totalCount.description: Products TikTok has for the window.

truncated.description: true when the page cap stopped the walk. Numbers then cover only the top products by GMV.

latestAvailableDate.description: Freshness marker. TikTok's analytics lag is typically T+1 to T+2.

productCard.description: Product card GMV by entry point, from TikTok Seller Center (TikTok's official API has no search channel). US shops only, and only while the shop's Seller Center session is active. Same window as the rest of the response, in US Pacific days. Seller Center has intraday values for today and yesterday, so a window past latestAvailableDate can show product card GMV the channels don't. Cached per shop and window for about 5 minutes. null when it can't be served (productCardReason says why); the rest of the response is unaffected.

total.description: Product card GMV, exact decimal string with at least 2 places (Seller Center's 338.6 comes back as 338.60). null when Seller Center sent no amount.

shopTab.description: Product card GMV from the shop tab.

other.description: Product card GMV from every other entry point.

productCardReason.description: Why productCard is null; null when it is present. no_seller_session: no seller web cookie on file, or no official token (the block needs both). region_not_supported: not a US shop (not called). session_expired: TikTok answered 98001002, the seller must log in again. captcha: TikTok challenged the call and one retry did not clear it. unexpected_response: the answer did not carry the expected metrics. upstream_error: any other failure, including an HTML or block page. timeout: Seller Center did not answer within about 8 seconds; the response went out without the block, and the late result is cached for the next request. A failure is remembered for about 2 minutes, so retrying sooner gets the same reason.

gmv.description: Decimal string in the response currency. affiliate_product_card has no TikTok block of its own: it is affiliate total minus affiliate video and LIVE, floored at 0 because TikTok may round each block on its own.

gmvShare.description: Share of total GMV, 0 to 1, rounded to 4 places, so the six may sum to 0.9999 to 1.0001. null when total GMV is 0 or unknown.

skuOrders.description: Seller channels only. TikTok gives affiliate orders only as a total (bySource.affiliate).

itemsSold.description: Seller channels only, same as skuOrders.

Money.description: TikTok's money object: amount as a decimal string, ISO currency code.

contentId.description: Video id, or LIVE room id.

startedAt.description: Video post time or LIVE start.

commission.description: Estimated creator commission, all-in as compass reports it.

days.description: Stored days with a row for this pair.
